title: 第21章 世上最最好的神第22章 喂养两天百姓长出血肉
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 战承胤起刀挥舞，有破空声传来……
他不由感叹道：“好刀！”
宋铎手持唐陌刀爱不释手，“属下打造兵器这么多年，未见如此坚韧锋利长刀。”
昨日拿精钢去锻造，精钢坚硬，熔点高，无需再锻打，能直接制作武器。
他原以为，那些精钢已够好。
今日见到这批陌刀，还是差太多。
这就是神明所赐予的军备么，比大启国强不知多少倍！
忽地，仓库又落下上千副铠甲。
铠甲制作精良，内外两层，外甲柳接锁甲，内里两层棉布和绒布。
宋铎用刀鞘重击铠甲。
铠甲没有凹陷，只有轻微划痕。
他惊喜无比，“将军，这铠甲，比咱们用的盔甲好！！”
战承胤手触碰冰冷的甲面，随手抽出自己的佩剑，蓦地砍在甲上。
呯~
他的剑断了。
而铠甲上只有一道划痕，甲锁未被砍断。
宋铎见状，顿时哈哈大笑。
“将军，这铠甲太好了！若我们有十万士兵，手持陌刀，身穿重铠甲，不说蛮族，其他六国也不放在眼里。”
只可惜，铠甲只有一千套。
每片盔甲用最坚硬的精钢打造，而这个时代，其他国家的铠甲，以青铜，陶瓷片，铁片，兽皮……
做不到全副精钢打造。
最后落下是秦弩。
军中有弩，是小型弩，而落下的是重型弓弩，弩长1.45米，是远程射击武器。
宋铎还未见过如此重型弩。
战承胤说：“去找几个弓箭手试弩。”
“是，将军！”
宋铎找来几位弓箭手，射击场上试弩。
弓箭手臂力大，饶是如此也未能拉弩。
最后，是陈魁将军块头大，脚踏于弓，臂力拉弦，用全身之力上弦。
箭刺破空，箭镞威力极大，速度于弓几倍，发出尖锐呼啸声。
前来围观的将领和士兵都震惊了。
弓弩威力之巨大，射程之远，射出六百米开外。
若是站立城墙射弓，射程更远。
重弩太适合守城！
content_en:
Zhan Chengyin raised his sword and waved it, and there was a sound of breaking through the air...
He couldn't help but sigh: "What a knife!"
Song Duo couldn't put it down holding Tang Mo Dao, "I have been making weapons for so many years, but I have never seen such a tough and sharp sword."
Yesterday I took fine steel for forging. Fine steel is hard and has a high melting point. It can be used to make weapons directly without forging.
He originally thought that those fine steels were good enough.
When I saw these Mo Dao today, they were still too different.
Is this the armament bestowed by the gods? It is countless times stronger than the Great Qi Kingdom!
Suddenly, thousands more pieces of armor fell from the warehouse.
The armor is well made, with two layers inside and outside, with willow on the outside connected to mail, and two layers of cotton and flannel on the inside.
Song Duo hit the armor hard with the scabbard.
The armor has no dents and only minor scratches.
He was extremely pleasantly surprised, "General, this armor is better than the armor we use!!"
Zhan Chengyin touched the cold armor with his hand, casually drew out his sword, and suddenly struck it on the armor.
Bah~
His sword was broken.
There was only one scratch on the armor, and the chain had not been cut off.
When Song Duo saw this, he burst into laughter.
"General, this armor is so good! If we have a hundred thousand soldiers, holding Mo swords and wearing heavy armor, not to mention the barbarians, the other six countries will not look down on us."
Unfortunately, there are only a thousand sets of armor.
Each piece of armor is made of the hardest stainless steel. In this era, the armor of other countries is made of bronze, ceramic sheets, iron sheets, animal skins...
It cannot be made entirely of fine steel.
The last one to fall was Qin Nu.
There are crossbows in the army, which are small crossbows, and the ones that fell are heavy crossbows. The crossbows are 1.45 meters long and are long-range shooting weapons.
Song Duo has never seen such a heavy crossbow.
Zhan Chengyin said: "Go and find some archers to try out the crossbow."
"Yes, General!"
Song Duo found some archers and tried out the crossbows at the shooting range.
His bow and arrow arm is very strong, even if he is so strong, he still cannot pull the crossbow.
Finally, it was General Chen Kui who was a big man. He put his feet on the bow, used his arms to pull the string, and used his whole body to wind it.
Phew...
The arrow pierces the air. The arrowhead is extremely powerful, its speed is several times faster than the bow, and it makes a sharp whistling sound.
Wow…
The generals and soldiers who came to watch were shocked.
The crossbow is extremely powerful and has a long range, shooting as far as 600 meters.
If you stand on the city wall and shoot your bow, the range will be farther.
The heavy crossbow is perfect for defending a city!
